meta.name: The Sunken Barrow
meta.description: An ancient burial mound, half-swallowed by the earth. Armored dead walk its halls and something older stirs below.
meta.author: Creator Skill

gmPrompt: You are a strict, no-nonsense game master who insists on physical plausibility. If a player tries to leap thirty feet or punch through stone, you refuse. You respect the constraints of the world — gravity, exhaustion, the weight of armor, the darkness of underground spaces. You describe combat with unflinching clarity: the crunch of bone, the scrape of iron on stone. You don't punish players for clever thinking, but 'clever' means solutions that could actually work in a damp, lightless tomb full of the restless dead.

monsters.name: Bone Rat
monsters.special: Swarms in packs of three; attacks the weakest target first.

monsters.name: Grave Worm
monsters.special: Erupts from soft earth underfoot without warning.

monsters.name: Shambling Corpse
monsters.special: Immune to pain; fights until physically destroyed.

monsters.name: Armored Skeleton
monsters.special: Reforms after one round unless bones are scattered or burned.

monsters.name: Barrow Wight
monsters.special: Touch drains warmth; failed WIL save causes paralysis for one round.

monsters.name: Cave Lurker
monsters.special: Blends with rock walls; always attacks from ambush.

monsters.name: Tomb Guardian
monsters.special: Bound to its post; will not pursue beyond its chamber.

monsters.name: Eldritch Crawler
monsters.special: Whispers maddening truths; failed WIL save causes confusion.

monsters.name: Bonelord
monsters.special: Commands lesser undead; destroying it disperses its minions.

monsters.name: The Pale Sovereign
monsters.special: An ancient king who refused death. His presence dims all light sources. Immune to non-magical weapons.

exits.label: Wade through to the far side
Take the passage beyond the chest

rubble: Broken stone chokes the passage, shoulder-high in places.
A ceiling collapse has left a treacherous slope of loose rock.
Shattered masonry crunches underfoot with every step.
broken_pillar: A carved pillar lies across the floor, split clean in two.
Cracked columns lean at dangerous angles, threatening to fall.
The stumps of pillars line the walls like broken teeth.
standing_water: Black water pools ankle-deep, hiding the floor beneath.
A still sheet of water reflects nothing — not even your light.
Cold water seeps from the walls and gathers in stagnant pools.
pit_trap: A section of floor has given way, revealing darkness below.
Loose flagstones shift underfoot — the mortar has rotted away.
A yawning pit splits the corridor, its bottom lost in shadow.
collapsed_rack: Wooden racks have rotted and spilled their contents across the floor.
Iron hooks hang empty from a collapsed frame.
A jumble of broken shelving blocks the far wall.
sarcophagi: Stone coffins line the walls, their lids cracked or displaced.
A row of sarcophagi stretches into the gloom, some standing open.
Heavy stone lids bear the carved likenesses of forgotten warriors.

dripping: Water drips somewhere ahead — steady as a heartbeat.
Each drop echoes in the silence, counting the seconds.
A slow drip rings against stone, impossibly loud in the stillness.
whispers: Voices murmur just below hearing, as though the walls are speaking.
A dry susurrus rises and falls — words in no living language.
Something whispers your name. Or perhaps it was the wind.
grinding: Stone scrapes against stone somewhere in the dark.
A low grinding reverberates through the floor — something shifting below.
The walls seem to groan under the weight of earth above.

torch_flicker: Your light gutters and dances, throwing wild shadows.
The flame bends toward the passage ahead as though drawn by breath.
Shadows leap and twist along the walls like living things.
glowing_moss: Pale moss clings to the ceiling, giving off a sickly green glow.
Patches of luminescent growth mark the damp stones.
A faint bioluminescence makes the walls seem to breathe.
darkness: The dark here is absolute — thick and close as velvet.
Your light barely reaches the walls. The dark presses in.
Beyond your circle of light, nothing. Only the dark.
fading_daylight: Grey daylight filters down from the entrance above, growing thin.
The last of the outside light dies a few steps ahead.
Pale shafts of light angle through cracks, catching the dust.

decay: The air is thick with the sweetness of old rot.
Something long dead breathes its last corruption into the air.
A charnel reek rises from the stones — death, layered deep.
damp_earth: The smell of wet earth and ancient stone fills your lungs.
It smells like a freshly turned grave down here.
Cold, mineral dampness coats the back of your throat.
incense: A ghost of incense lingers — sandalwood and something older.
The air carries a faint sweetness, like temple smoke long dispersed.
Old offerings have left their fragrance soaked into the stone.
iron_tang: The air tastes of iron — old blood or rusted metal.
A metallic sharpness pricks your tongue with each breath.
Rust and something darker coat the air in this place.

cold_draft: A chill breath of air moves through the passage — from where?
The cold here has weight. It settles on your shoulders.
An icy draft cuts through your clothing without mercy.
oppressive: The weight of the earth above presses down on your mind.
The air is close and heavy, thick with centuries of silence.
Something in this place does not want you here. You feel it.
ancient: This place is old beyond reckoning. You feel it in the stone.
The dust here has not been disturbed in a very long time.
Everything speaks of age — the worn steps, the faded carvings.
peaceful: A strange calm settles over you. The dead rest easy here.
The air is still and clean. Whatever haunts this barrow has not touched this place.
You feel safe here, though you cannot say why.
